source_name: sdfm.gov.ua — legacy SFMS website
why_relevant: Predecessor domain of the SFMS, still referenced as carrying official information and historical archives (annual reports, older typologies) that may not have migrated to fiu.gov.ua. Useful for backfill.

source_name: data.gov.ua — tag-filtered discovery views (небанківська фінансова установа / фінансова)
why_relevant: Tag-based facets on the national portal act as a cheap, repeatable discovery loop for financial-sector datasets across all publishers (NBU, Ministry of Justice, NSSMC, Ministry of Finance), surfacing register datasets that are never linked from the regulators' own sites.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — сторінка Держфінмоніторингу (SFMS coordination page)
why_relevant: SFMS is coordinated through the Minister of Finance, and the binding AML reporting procedures are issued as MoF orders (наказ Мінфіну), not SFMS acts. The MoF page is the pointer that connects the FIU to the ministry that actually issues its normative acts.

source_name: diia.data.gov.ua — Де знайти відкриті дані (open data portal directory)
why_relevant: State-run index of Ukrainian open-data portals beyond data.gov.ua (regional portals, sectoral portals, agency portals). Pure source-discovery surface for finding register mirrors and secondary publication points when a primary register goes dark.

source_name: data.gov.ua — National Bank of Ukraine as data publisher
why_relevant: State open-data catalogue page enumerating every dataset the NBU is legally obliged to publish — a pointer that reveals NBU data assets not linked from the main site, including registry sets tied to licensing and supervision obligations.

source_name: MFA of Ukraine — Cooperation with international financial institutions
why_relevant: Actor-map page enumerating the IFIs engaged with Ukraine (IMF, WB, EBRD, EIB, IFC) with links — a cheap way to enumerate the assessor/conditionality landscape and its Ukrainian official naming.

source_name: «Онлайн-моніторинг» — урядова діджитал-платформа моніторингу законодавства
why_relevant: Government-announced platform for one-click legislation monitoring; the announcement page is the pointer to the live service and to how the executive itself tracks legislative change. Worth resolving to the actual platform URL and assessing coverage of financial-sector acts.

source_name: CSIRT of the State Scientific and Research Institute of Cybersecurity Technologies and Information Protection — regulatory framework pages
why_relevant: A curated, maintained index of Ukraine's cyber-defence and critical-infrastructure legal framework, including a dedicated page on the CI-protection legal base. Excellent snowball hub for orders and methodological recommendations that never surface in financial-regulator searches.

source_name: Портал відкритих даних ВРУ — API та каталог наборів (ogd)
why_relevant: Documents the machine access contract (dataset passports updated hourly under /ogd/, list.csv/json/xml catalogues, ~610 datasets) and is the discovery surface for further Rada datasets — votes, agendas, sessions, MPs — that enrich bill-stage tracking.

source_name: regulation.gov.ua — catalogue of state functions and permits (NBU register-keeping function id5592)
why_relevant: State deregulation portal cataloguing each regulator's statutory functions and the permits attached to them, including NBU's duty to keep the register of payment systems, settlement systems, their participants and payment-infrastructure service operators. Reveals the legal basis, permit types and procedural deadlines behind each register entry — a structural map of the licensing surface.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua legacy 'Інтерв'ю та виступи' archive
why_relevant: Legacy NBU site category that preserved the dedicated 'Interviews and speeches' listing before the current site merged speeches into the general news feed. Valuable as a historical corpus for lead-time calibration (how long before a rule appeared did an official first mention it), which the current feed makes harder to reconstruct.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua — NBU legacy website archive
why_relevant: Legacy NBU CMS still serving historical articles and act listings that were not migrated; valuable for reconstructing pre-2019 resolution history and for retrieving documents 404-ing on the modern site.

source_name: Каталог фінтех-компаній України (Fintech companies catalogue, association-produced)
why_relevant: Association-produced directory of Ukrainian fintech companies, redistributed via a Ukrainian MFA embassy site. A ready-made map of the non-bank payments ecosystem — private companies whose procurement and vendor relationships never surface on public portals.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA Ukraine) / American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine — member firm content & committees
why_relevant: Business associations host banking/financial-services committees where member advisers (Baker McKenzie, Big-4) circulate regulatory positions and comment on NBU drafts. Republishes member-firm news; a route to consultation-stage adviser positions that never appear as public alerts.

source_name: ЄМА — Члени асоціації (member list)
why_relevant: Member roster = map of the banks, PSPs, processors and vendors active in Ukrainian payments. Per the cell rationale this is the pointer into the private-sector ecosystem whose procurement never appears on public portals.

source_name: AUB — Members list and statutory documents
why_relevant: Member roster + governing documents. Pointer to the bank universe represented in consultations; the AUB Statute is also registered in the state legal database (zakon.rada.gov.ua v0002697-95, 08.06.1995), giving a verifiable legal identity.

source_name: NABU event pages — Fintech & Payments Forum 2026 (agenda + speaker list)
why_relevant: Conference agendas are the cell's core artefact: session titles name the exact rule topics under negotiation and the panel lists name the officials who own them, giving both the topic and the person to watch.

source_name: AFME European Financial Integration Conference — NBU keynote venue
why_relevant: Example of the offshore venue class: NBU First Deputy Governor Serhiy Nikolaychuk gave a keynote at AFME's European Financial Integration Conference 2026 (Frankfurt, 19 May 2026). International industry conferences are where Ukrainian officials state EU-alignment sequencing to a market audience, and these appearances are easily missed by UA-only monitoring.

source_name: Ukrainian Law Firms (ukrainianlawfirms.com) — annual handbook of leading firms
why_relevant: Actor-map source rather than a content source: an annual directory of Ukrainian firms with practice profiles, letting the cell enumerate every firm with a banking/finance or fintech practice instead of relying on the five seed names. Pair with Legal500 and Chambers UA rankings.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk) entity pages for the associations
why_relevant: Cheap entity-resolution layer: settles the NABU naming ambiguity (Незалежна vs Національна асоціація банків України — the association itself uses both across its own page titles) and the AUB/UKBS founding facts and aliases. Also disambiguates from the unrelated НАБУ = Національне антикорупційне бюро України, a serious query-noise trap.

source_name: ДП «Преса» — передплата на «Офіційний вісник України» (журнал, on-line, off-line, «зі змінами»)
why_relevant: Documents the actual commercial access routes to the gazette itself: print (subscription index 40433), electronic/CD (index 48345), on-line and a consolidated 'зі змінами' edition. Establishes that a fully authoritative gazette feed is a paid product and identifies which SKU to buy if verbatim gazette text is required.
